name: Koromogawari
source:
It was the end of the year.
As usual, the main character, Yasuto, who came to a doujinshi sale by himself, happened to meet a girl classmate, Rina Kadokura, at the cosplay space.
Although they both have otaku hobbies, they quickly hit it off because they didn’t have anyone close to them to talk to.
With that as an opportunity, the relationship between the two of them progressed rapidly.
translation:
年末，主人公康人独自来到同人志展会，偶然在角色扮演区遇到女同学门仓里菜。

两人都有御宅族兴趣，却因为身边没有可以交流的人而迅速投缘。以此为契机，两人的关系飞速发展。
